message:
docs(history): a PASS count is a result only if the process exited

The "17 PASS" reported and accepted this round was not a result. It was where the
process stopped -- it died before the eighteenth assertion printed, leaving only the
passes that had already reached the screen. Without the exit code, "everything up to
here passed" and "everything passed" look identical.

So: read the PASS count, the exit code and the closing summary line together, compare
counts only across the same set of cases, and never close an intermittent fault on a
single green run.

Three instances of the same mistake today: a missing result: line in updater.log read
as success, five suites that print no PASS lines at all disappearing into a sweep
total, and this. Each time the failure was not checking separately that the report
ran to the end.
